name: One container, twelve UI states: cursor-driven shape changes on a 2 s beat (square)

source.location: external: user reference folder (resolve with --root or MOTION_REFERENCE_ROOTS); never copied into the repository
source.creator: unknown

rights.attribution: Unknown creator; supplied by the user as a private study reference.
rights.notes: No marks seen; generic UI with placeholder copy. Rights unverified; reuse the container-continuity principle only.

analysis.inspected_by: agent (GitHub Copilot, session B) using the reference-analyst workflow
analysis.method: Viewed overview (19 frames), the transitions sheet (all 3 boundaries, every 2nd frame = 30 fps for this 60 fps file) and the listen sheet (10 accent hits at -0.1/0/+0.1 s); automated audio and listen metrics (signal features; Windows desktop dictation for speech; nothing was listened to).
analysis.coverage: Full 14.0 s; the three detected changes at 30 fps, the others from the overview and the listen frames.

concept.observed: A square loop on a pale grey canvas: one black control becomes a button, a check, a music player, a volume slider, a toggle, a segmented control, a chart card, a search input, a command palette and a toast, then returns to the button; a cursor triggers every change.
concept.interpreted: Continuity of one container makes twelve interface features feel like one product.

communication_style.observed: Generic UI copy only; no headline and no voice.

palette.observed: Pale warm grey canvas (#e8e8e8, 73%), black controls, white cards and one orange-violet gradient thumbnail; mean luma 0.87.

composition.observed: One centred element, 25-60% of the frame width, always in the same place, with generous empty space.

motion.observed: The container tweens size and corner radius in 0.2-0.33 s; content fades out before and in after; numbers roll (7.7-9.2 s); a query types into the search field (10.4-11.4 s); the cursor moves with ease-in-out and presses.

easing.observed: Box changes settle without overshoot in 6-8 frames at 30 fps (power-style ease-out), read from the transitions sheet.

transitions.observed: No cuts. Three soft boundaries and about nine undetected changes, all one family (continuous, container transform): the pill grows into the player card 1.73-1.99 s (0.26 s, content after the box); the player card shrinks into the volume slider 3.73-3.99 s (content fades 3.76-3.83 s, before the box lands); the palette collapses into a toast pill 11.90-12.20 s. From the overview: button to spinner to check (0.4-1.1 s), slider to toggle (4.8-5.5 s), toggle to segmented control (6.3-6.5 s), segmented control to chart card (7.0-7.7 s), chart card to input (9.2-9.95 s), input to palette (9.95-10.7 s), toast back to the button (12.2-12.9 s, the loop point).
transitions.interpreted: A container transform needs no cut because the box carries the eye, and each change is caused by a visible press.

sound_design.observed: -14.1 LUFS, LRA 0.9 LU (flat), true peak -1.0 dBTP; tempo estimate 118 bpm (medium); 17 accents (73/min). Six accents sit on a 2.00 s grid (2.35, 4.34, 6.36, 8.34, 10.36, 12.35 s, within 20 ms) and four off-beats 0.25 s later (2.60, 4.60, 6.59, 8.61 s); each falls on a cursor press, a slider drag or a toggle (listen frames). 0 of 3 boundaries carry an accent (chance 0.22); 2 of 3 boundaries are within 50 ms of an onset (chance 0.44; too few to mean anything); no silences; head +0.7 dB, tail -1.7 dB. Accents may be part of the music.
sound_design.interpreted: The interactions were timed to the music's grid, so each click is heard as a click.

narration.observed: None: dictation kept 0 words (4 raw words) over music.
narration.interpreted: Text-led film: the copy is on screen, timed to the music.

captions.observed: None; the only copy is inside the UI (labels, a track title, a search query, a toast).

scenes.observed: Button pressed; a spinner becomes a check.
Music player card; play pressed, progress moves.
Chart card with a rolling total and a tooltip.
Input, then a command palette with a typed query.
Back to the first button (loop hold 13.19-13.94 s).

moments.observed: The player's content fades in 0.1 s while the card shrinks into a slider in 0.26 s; the slider fill is already moving under the cursor when the box lands.
moments.interpreted: Overlapping the content swap with the box move hides the seam.

uncertainties: Size and corner-radius easing read from every-2nd-frame sheets, not measured frame by frame
Whether the off-beat accents are interface sounds or the music
